```{r}
rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)

ancestry_colors <- c("#add8e6", "#FEF5C3", "#fdc0cb")
```

```{r}
megatable <- read.csv("../data/pangenome_project_megatable.csv")

proportion <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Ancestry", "AA_Admixture_Proportion", "EA_Admixture_Proportion", "EAA_Admixture_Proportion")]
```

```{r}
colnames(proportion)[colnames(proportion) == "AA_Admixture_Proportion"] <- "AA"
colnames(proportion)[colnames(proportion) == "EA_Admixture_Proportion"] <- "EA"
colnames(proportion)[colnames(proportion) == "EAA_Admixture_Proportion"] <- "EAA"
```

```{r}
boxplot <- function(y_var, y_label) {
  
  y_var <- ensym(y_var)
  
  set.seed(1)
  ggplot(proportion, aes(Ancestry, !!y_var, fill = Ancestry)) + 
    stat_boxplot(
      geom = "errorbar", 
      width = 0.3, 
      color = "black", 
      size = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.6,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 1,
      color = "black",
      size = 0.6) +
    labs(
      # title = plot_title, 
      x = element_blank(), 
      y = y_label) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
      "AA_Patients" = "African",
      "EA_Patients" = "European",
      "EAA_Patients" = "East Asian")) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = ancestry_colors) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.1,
      size = 2,
      shape = 21,
      fill = NA,
      alpha = 0.9) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      legend.position.inside = c(0.88, 0.88),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      # panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
      # panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),  
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.line.y.left   = element_line(color = "black")
    ) 
}
```

```{r}
AA_output <- boxplot(AA, "Admixture % African Ancestry")
AA_output
ggsave("./plot/supp1_ancestry_score_boxplot_AA.pdf", AA_output, width = 5, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
EA_output <- boxplot(EA, "Admixture % European Ancestry")
EA_output
ggsave("./plot/supp1_ancestry_score_boxplot_EA.pdf", EA_output, width = 5, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
